# 2D icon prompt pack: every unit and structure, Tiers 1-4

Generated from `docs/audit/roster.json` (391 distinct types: 227 units + 164 structures, keyed by the
AoE4World base id used in `viewer/stats.js`). Machine-readable copy: `docs/audit/icon-prompts.json`.

**Tier = Age.** Tier 1 is the Age I look, Tier 4 the Age IV (imperial) look. The silhouette is identical
at every tier; only materials, construction and ornament escalate. For a unit or building that only
appears in a later age, T1/T2 still show the same object in a plainer, pre-upgrade state.

## Shared style block (already inside every prompt)

> hand-painted cel-shaded strategy-game icon, thick near-black casing outline, flat two-to-three-tone materials with soft gradients, warm rim light from the upper left, soft contact shadow, single subject centred, three-quarter view, filling 85 percent of a square frame, readable at 32 pixels, cohesive with the rest of the set, original design. square 512x512 PNG, transparent background, no text, no letters, no numbers, no frame, no border, no watermark, no extra props, no scenery beyond the contact shadow.

**Negative prompt (pass to every generation):**

> text, letters, numbers, watermark, signature, border, frame, background scenery, multiple subjects, collage, UI chrome, photorealistic, 3D render, blurry, thin hairlines, low contrast, cropped subject.

**Naming:** `icon_<unit|structure>_<id>_t<tier>.png`, e.g. `icon_unit_man-at-arms_t3.png`.
